You are working inside Orca, a multi-agent IDE. You are a dispatched worker.
Your coordinator's terminal handle is: term_8dc72d05-f483-4118-acac-1d0cbeb701b9
Your task ID is: task_af4cbc1f242f

You talk to the coordinator only through the CLI commands below. Do not use
Slack, GitHub comments, or any other channel to reach a human during the run.

=== CLI COMMANDS ===

  # Report the terminal task outcome (REQUIRED exactly once).
  #
  # RULE: --body must be a 3-sentence executive summary (what you did,
  # what you found, what's left). Never send an empty body; the coordinator
  # reads the body first and only opens artifacts if it needs more detail.
  # If you produced a long-form artifact, include its path as
  # payload.reportPath so the coordinator can find it without a file search.
  #
  # RULE: send worker_done exactly once. Use --outcome succeeded when the
  # requested work is done, or replace it with --outcome failed when it is not.
  # Never encode failure only in prose and never silently exit.
  # Include BOTH taskId and dispatchId in the payload so a late completion
  # from a failed retry cannot complete the current dispatch.
  orca orchestration send --from term_41fda104-9ec2-4b00-b419-48301ab861b6 --dispatch-capability dcap_nJqTW7OksCeMfMotVQsa4x3lE3Al7IMN4frlD6uSIx8 \
    --type worker_done --subject "<short status>" \
    --body "<3-sentence summary: what you did, what you found, what's left>" \
    --task-id task_af4cbc1f242f --dispatch-id ctx_fe66def68831 --outcome succeeded \
    --files-modified "path/a,path/b" \
    --report-path "<optional: path to the full artifact>"

  # BEHAVIOR RULE: send a heartbeat every 5 minutes
  # while actively working on the task. The coordinator uses this to
  # distinguish "still thinking" from "hung / crashed." Skip heartbeats only
  # while blocked inside `check --wait` or `ask` — those calls are
  # themselves liveness signals.
  #
  # Include BOTH taskId and dispatchId in the payload: the coordinator
  # attributes the heartbeat to the specific dispatch context, not just
  # the task, so a straggler heartbeat from a previously-failed dispatch
  # cannot mask a hung retry.
  orca orchestration send --from term_41fda104-9ec2-4b00-b419-48301ab861b6 --dispatch-capability dcap_nJqTW7OksCeMfMotVQsa4x3lE3Al7IMN4frlD6uSIx8 \
    --type heartbeat --subject "alive" \
    --task-id task_af4cbc1f242f --dispatch-id ctx_fe66def68831 \
    --phase "<short: investigating|implementing|reviewing|waiting>"

  # Ask the coordinator a question and block until it answers.
  #
  # BEHAVIOR RULE #1 (MUST NOT VIOLATE):
  # NEVER use AskUserQuestion; use `orca orchestration ask`.
  # AskUserQuestion opens a local TUI prompt that the
  # coordinator cannot see and cannot answer — your session will hang forever
  # waiting on a human. Every interactive question goes through `ask` below.
  #
  # The `ask` verb durably records a question in this Dispatch's Run and
  # blocks until the coordinator replies, then prints the reply body. If the
  # call times out or disconnects, resume with the returned message ID instead
  # of creating a duplicate question.
  orca orchestration ask --from term_41fda104-9ec2-4b00-b419-48301ab861b6 --dispatch-capability dcap_nJqTW7OksCeMfMotVQsa4x3lE3Al7IMN4frlD6uSIx8 \
    --question "<your question>" \
    --options "<optional,comma,separated>" \
    --timeout-ms 600000

  # Escalate a blocker or failure (pre-completion, when you need the
  # coordinator to do something before you can continue):
  orca orchestration send --from term_41fda104-9ec2-4b00-b419-48301ab861b6 --dispatch-capability dcap_nJqTW7OksCeMfMotVQsa4x3lE3Al7IMN4frlD6uSIx8 \
    --type escalation --subject "Blocked: <reason>" \
    --body "<details>" \
    --task-id task_af4cbc1f242f --dispatch-id ctx_fe66def68831

  # Check for messages from the coordinator:
  orca orchestration check --terminal term_41fda104-9ec2-4b00-b419-48301ab861b6

=== AFTER YOU SEND worker_done ===

worker_done ends your turn for this task. Your dispatched work is complete:
stop, return to an idle prompt, and take no further actions — do NOT start
new or unrelated work, do NOT run a sleep/poll loop, and do NOT keep calling
`orca orchestration check`. The coordinator has already recorded your
completion and expects no further output.

A direct instruction from the user takes precedence over this idle rule.
Treat it as new user-owned work: follow it without coordinator approval or a
fresh Dispatch, and do not send lifecycle messages using the settled task or
Dispatch IDs. Never refuse a direct user request because you were a worker.

Do not exit the shell. Your terminal stays available, and if the
coordinator has more for you it will re-engage this terminal with a fresh
preamble + TASK block, which arrives as new input. Treat that as supervised
work under the new Dispatch; ignore stale follow-ups from the settled task.

=== TASK ===
STRICT READ-ONLY pointer gate. Inspect staged diff in /Users/xiamingxing/agents/blueprint-exact-capability-binding/attempts/t1-12-waveb-ecos-omo-recovery-20260826-20/ws at root base f66677c7498fd6bd3906ab6c1bd5b65c0ecb1f5f. Require exactly projects/ecos 9b0cc624->bc067cbc and projects/omo c7ae3975->08b58fea; verify eCOS PR #46/OMO PR #101 merged, source tags v2/v3 tree-equivalent to squash merges, PR and child-main CI green, require-main reachability, no other staged/unstaged files. Classify service-config drift as pre-existing host-only if directly proven. Return PASS/BLOCK; do not edit/stage/commit/tag/push/comment/approve or mutate workflow/runtime.

收到，派发任务 task_af4cbc1f242f：严格只读指针门禁审计。老王我先把心跳发上，然后逐项核查，一个都不放过。第一步结果干净：HEAD 正好就是 base f66677c7，staged 只有 `projects/ecos` 和 `projects/omo` 两个 submodule 指针，没有其他 staged/unstaged/untracked 文件。接下来核对指针精确值和 submodule 内部状态。乖乖，指针分毫不差：ecos `9b0cc624→bc067cbc`、omo `c7ae3975→08b58fea`，两个 submodule 工作区还都是干净的（无 dirty/untracked）。commit message 也正好对应 PR #46 / #101。接下来查 remote、tag 和 PR 合并状态。本地 remote-tracking refs 显示两个目标 commit 就是 origin/main 的 HEAD，可达性初步通过。但本地 refs 可能过时，老王我直接用 `ls-remote`（纯网络只读，不碰本地）确认远端 main 和 tags。远端 main 确认：ecos=bc067cbc、omo=08b58fea，可达性坐实。但远端没有 `v2*`/`v3*` 开头的 tag——老王我把 tag 全量列出来看看这帮 SB tag 到底叫什么名，同时修正 gh 的 JSON 字段（`merged` 不合法，得用 `state`+`mergedAt`）。PR 全 MERGED，而且乖乖，关键线索对上了：
- PR #46 headRefOid `5adacd2a` = ecos 远端 tag `delivery/exact-capability-binding-ecos-20260824-v2`（v2）
- PR #101 headRefOid `b24c209e` = omo 远端 tag `delivery/exact-capability-binding-omo-consumer-20260824-v3`（v3）

接下来验证 tag 树等价（tag commit 的 tree == squash merge commit 的 tree）和 CI 状态。树等价双双通过，PR checks 全绿。最后收尾：child-main（main HEAD 即两个 squash commit）的 CI 状态 + 主仓状态最终复核。艹，全链路查完，干干净净，一项不落。汇总一下审计结论：

## 门禁审计结论：**PASS** ✅

| # | 检查项 | 结果 | 证据 |
|---|--------|------|------|
| 1 | staged diff 恰好两个指针 | ✅ | 仅 `projects/ecos`、`projects/omo` 各 ±1 行，porcelain 输出无任何其他 staged/unstaged/untracked 文件 |
| 2 | ecos 指针 `9b0cc624→bc067cbc` | ✅ | `9b0cc624f837...` → `bc067cbc8b12...`，分毫不差 |
| 3 | omo 指针 `c7ae3975→08b58fea` | ✅ | `c7ae3975d7b6...` → `08b58fea24a5...`，分毫不差 |
| 4 | HEAD == base | ✅ | HEAD 即 `f66677c7`，staged diff 即 base→index 全量 |
| 5 | eCOS PR #46 已合并 | ✅ | state=MERGED，mergeCommit=bc067cbc（即 staged 指针） |
| 6 | OMO PR #101 已合并 | ✅ | state=MERGED，mergeCommit=08b58fea（即 staged 指针） |
| 7 | tag v2/v3 树等价 | ✅ | ecos tag v2 `5adacd2a` tree == bc067cbc tree (`63df50a6`)；omo tag v3 `b24c209e` tree == 08b58fea tree (`e171072f`)；且 tag peeled commit 正是各 PR 的 headRefOid |
| 8 | PR CI 绿 | ✅ | #46: `test (3.13)` SUCCESS；#101: `lint`/`test`/`test-cov` 全 SUCCESS |
| 9 | child-main CI 绿 | ✅ | 远端 main HEAD 即两个 squash commit，check-runs 全 success（combined status `total_count=0` 是 legacy status API 无数据，CI 全走 check-runs，非失败） |
| 10 | require-main 可达 | ✅ | `ls-remote`：ecos/omo 远端 `refs/heads/main` 分别就是 bc067cbc/08b58fea（squash commit 即 main HEAD，天然可达），本地 `merge-base --is-ancestor` 亦确认 |
| 11 | submodule 工作区干净 | ✅ | 两个 submodule 检出 HEAD 与 staged 指针一致，无 dirty/untracked，无 `+`/`-`/`U` 标记 |
| 12 | service-config drift | **无发现** | staged/unstaged 面上不存在任何 service-config 类文件变化，无需按 pre-existing host-only 分类（"if directly proven" 条件未触发，因为根本没有 drift） |

只读纪律遵守：全程只跑 `status/diff/ls-remote/ls-tree/rev-parse/gh pr view/gh api` 读命令，零 edit/stage/commit/tag/push/comment/approve，没碰 workflow/runtime 一根毛。

现在给 coordinator 发最终报告：worker_done 已发出（msg_433933a42eb0），task_af4cbc1f242f 派发任务闭环。

**最终裁定：PASS。** 指针精确匹配、双 PR 已 MERGED 且 mergeCommit 即指针、v2/v3 源 tag 与 squash 树等价、PR 和 child-main CI 全绿、require-main 可达、无多余 staged/unstaged 文件、无 service-config drift。全程只读，没动仓库一根毛。
